stages.title: Foundation
stages.purpose: Establish a secure, portable Windows workstation around Hermes Agent and llama.cpp.
stages.successCriteria: Native launcher, local inference, profiles, diagnostics, recovery, benchmarks and security controls are validated.

stages.title: Reliable Platform
stages.purpose: Remove fatal and opaque failure modes before expanding the control plane.
stages.successCriteria: Cold starts, lifecycle transitions and recovery paths fail clearly and recover predictably.

stages.title: Operational Control Plane
stages.purpose: Make every long-running workstation operation observable, durable and recoverable.
stages.successCriteria: Shared task state, update orchestration, focused operational surfaces and failure-path evidence.

stages.title: Inference Fabric
stages.purpose: Create stable contracts for multiple inference runtimes, planning, telemetry and certification.
stages.successCriteria: Backends can be compared, selected and recovered through one hardware-aware orchestration layer.

stages.title: Intelligent Optimisation
stages.purpose: Turn hardware telemetry and benchmark evidence into safe, workload-specific tuning.
stages.successCriteria: AutoTune improves useful capability, speed or memory use without silently degrading quality or stability.

stages.title: Agent Ecosystem
stages.purpose: Expand trusted tools, memory, projects, routing and experimental integrations.
stages.successCriteria: New capabilities are permission-scoped, reproducible and promoted through measurable certification gates.

stages.title: Version 1.0
stages.purpose: Deliver a dependable Windows distribution suitable for supported non-technical users.
stages.successCriteria: Guided install, verified runtimes, signing, provenance, maintenance and data-preserving recovery are release-ready.
